reply_text:
Found four issues before merging:

1. **P1 — Short text gets truncated too** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`
   `excerpt('hello world', 20)` returns `"hello…"`, and empty text returns `"…"`. This violates the documented unchanged-at-or-below-limit behavior.
   **Fix:** Return early when text fits; only append an ellipsis when content was removed.

2. **P1 — Helpers aren’t connected to cards** — `src/card.js:2`
   Cards still return the full, raw body. Neither `excerpt` nor `toPlain` has a production caller, so merging won’t actually produce card previews.
   **Fix:** Wire plain-text conversion and excerpting into the card body path, with a defined preview limit and an integration test.

3. **P2 — Exact word boundaries discard an extra word** — `src/words.js:2–4`
   `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `"one…"` instead of `"one two…"`. The slice excludes the space at index 7, so the helper falls back to the previous boundary.
   **Fix:** Include the boundary at `limit` when searching for the last space.

4. **P2 — Common Markdown markers remain visible** — `src/plain.js:3–5`
   `toPlain('# Heading\n\n- First\n- Second')` returns `"# Heading - First - Second"`, despite the documented marker removal.
   **Fix:** Handle heading/list syntax before collapsing whitespace, or use a Markdown-to-text parser.

All four existing tests pass, but they don’t cover these cases. No files changed.
